verdict.rationale: The CLI documents a first-party `skills init [name]` command that creates a new SKILL.md template (e.g. `npx skills init my-skill`). The Agent Skills spec says SKILL.md must contain YAML frontmatter followed by Markdown, notes that agents load each skill's name and description at startup, and documents optional fields plus a `skills-ref validate` check. Missing for 10: evidence showing the generated template's actual contents (that it pre-fills name/description frontmatter), an explicit list of name/description as required spec fields, and a hands-on run of `skills init`.
